items.text: films every concert and never watches it back
has thousands of unread messages and a storage warning on the phone
replies to every voice note with a thumbs up
changes their profile photo every week, always with the same filter
posts a rest day story from the sofa
has a folder of drafts they never post
says they're off their phone, then posts from the bathroom
screenshots every message as evidence for a future argument
keeps a streak alive on an app they never open
writes a long caption and then posts a single emoji
has the group chat on and everything else muted
reads every story but never likes one
deletes a post and reposts it with a new filter
forgets to charge the phone until it hits 2% at 6pm
keeps a close friends list with exactly one name on it
checks the weather app more often than their own messages
records a six-minute voice note that is mostly breathing
sends lol after a serious message
creates a playlist for every mood and plays the same one
never understands the app update and pretends they do
gives every food delivery five stars, no matter what
posts an I hate social media rant, then deletes it an hour later
scrolls through their own posts from 2019 before bed
runs a secret account just to watch their friends' stories
uses a filter that makes them look like an oil painting
checks the likes like a bank balance
sends the same meme three times in one chat
joins every group chat and never says a word
uses the wrong emoji in a condolence message
puts the phone face up at dinner, just for the photos
muted their mum's chat and forgot to unmute it
watches every cat video but scrolls past the sad news
buys a new phone case every single month
leaves the shared photo album unlabelled out of protest
posts the same sunset from the same balcony every week
